items.title: Central European leaders criticize EU budget proposal allocating €130 billion to Ukraine
items.summary: The prime ministers of Slovakia, Hungary, Poland and the Czech Republic criticized the EU's proposed 2028–2034 budget, according to a report. Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico urged the bloc to prioritize lowering European energy costs, while Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis said the proposal earmarks €130 billion for Ukraine.
